title: R2 Carbon Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Serving closed-circuit and supersport riders, the Schuberth R2 Carbon Anthracite is purpose-built for closed-course competition and apex carving. Featuring a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber architecture at a featherweight 1331g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~93 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Long Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Schuberth's first pure race helmet with carbon shell and MIPS.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for track use with a tight, aerodynamic fit; requires precise sizing due to limited adjustment range compared to street models.

technical_analysis: Features Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels paired with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna. The interior utilizes Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Schuberth R2 Carbon Anthracite: combining Germany 🇩🇪 craftsmanship with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna and Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Schuberth R2 Carbon Anthracite: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Schuberth R2 Carbon Anthracite. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Long Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Schuberth's Track / Race lineup, the R2 Carbon Anthracite brings German engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Long Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Schuberth R2 Carbon Anthracite represents Schuberth's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~93 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to a Long Oval head shape, the Schuberth R2 Carbon Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
